title: Canary sandbox probe for function contract stability with probationary routing and auto-unwind
creator: Marco Liu
description: Build a sandboxed canary probe that runs new model variants against live and shadow traffic to detect function-call / structured-output contract drift. The probe should exercise: 1) real request inputs in a sandboxed runtime that prevents side effects, 2) a differential comparator that scores function-signature and schema divergence, and 3) an automated probationary routing controller that can throttle or unwind traffic when contract regressions are detected. This ticket covers the engine + telemetry + automated rollback hooks — not UI for engineers (separate task).
acceptance_criteria: Sandboxed invocation runner that executes canary variant without permitting outbound side effects (no network/DB writes) and returns full response + lineage tags
Comparator that computes a per-invocation 'contract_delta_score' capturing: schema shape diffs, missing/extra function calls, changed argument types, and tool response status changes
Probationary routing controller able to start at 0.5% live traffic, hold windows, and auto-increase to 5% if contract_delta_score < configured threshold for N consecutive windows
Auto-unwind (rollback) rule that re-routes traffic away and triggers an alert + incident template when schema_mismatch_rate > 0.5% or contract_delta_p95 > 0.1 for a 10-minute window
Dashboards and alerting: per-variant contract_delta distribution, schema_mismatch_rate, p95 latency, and user-visible error spike correlated by lineage tags
Shadow-only mode integrated: can run the comparator on 100% shadowed traffic without affecting live routing and persist diffs to the canary index
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Feature-flagged sandbox runner and comparator (internal only). Phase 2: Shadow-mode runs against production traffic for one week; collect metrics. Phase 3: Probationary routing at 0.5% for 1 hour; if stable, step to 1% for 4 hours, then 5% for 24 hours. Hold windows after each step for manual review. Phase 4: Promote to gradual rollout or auto-rollout depending on config. Each step evaluates schema_mismatch_rate and contract_delta_score. If thresholds exceeded, trigger auto-unwind and notify on-call.
test_plan: Unit tests for comparator with synthetic schema drift scenarios (added field, removed field, type-change). Integration tests that run sandboxed invocation against a local mock model and assert no side-effect channels were used. End-to-end staging run that shadows real traffic for 48 hours and verifies metric ingestion. Chaos tests: inject upstream tool failures and validate that comparator differentiates tool-level failures vs contract changes.
technical_notes: Sandbox runner will reuse existing invocation isolation primitives in runtime: sandboxed process with network policy deny, write-fs readonly, and no-KV-commit mode. Comparator will produce structured diffs: path-based additions/removals, type-mismatch ratios, and function-call presence/absence with confidence bands. We'll store diffs to the canary index (time-series per variant) and tag telemetry with 'variant_id' and 'canary_epoch'. Probation controller will live in the routing service; it reads metric windows from the metrics store and applies traffic-weight changes via the routing API. Auto-unwind implements hysteresis: immediate rollback on critical thresholds, and probationary cooldown before retries.
